USTAR/old-GNU TAR reader and writer for Solana snapshot streams.

# Purpose
This header defines the `fd_tar` interface for reading and writing TAR archives in the `ustar` and old-GNU formats. It declares the packed `fd_tar_meta_t` header layout, constants for block size and file types, and helper functions for parsing and setting header fields such as size and modification time. It also declares a streaming reader API with callbacks for file headers and file data, plus a streaming writer API for creating archives, writing file content, finishing files, and reserving space for later write-back. The code is intended for Solana snapshot archive handling and is not a general-purpose TAR implementation.
